Possible double-count against P4777 (Phase I network aggregate, 825.00 km). Evidence FOR: chndaqi.com (Shangrao 14th FYP energy plan) explicitly groups this branch under '天然气管网一期' (gas network Phase I) construction -- '加快天然气管网一期乐平-德兴-婺源支线管道、广丰-玉山支线管道的天然气管网工程建设' (accelerate Phase I network construction of the Leping-Dexing-Wuyuan branch [and] the Guangfeng-Yushan branch). Separately, per the coordinator's note, batch_01's own __VALIDITY__ finding on P4777 already used GEM's route geometry (never citable, but documented reasoning) to observe that the 12 Phase-I-LABELLED rows merge to 798.74 km, and adding this row plus P5889's route geometry brings the total to 853.36 km -- the sheet's 825.00 km sits inside that band (+3.4% at the high end). That is a geometric/internal signal only, not sourcing, but it is directionally consistent with this row being inside the same corridor bundle P4777 aggregates.
Evidence AGAINST: the Jiangxi DRC plan (jx_plan.txt/shared_evidence.md) names Phase I's specific 870km as-built total as exactly SIX trunks + the Tiannan-Shanggao branch (P4776/P4778/P4779/P4780/P4781/P4782/P4783) -- Guangfeng-Yushan is NOT among those seven named items. So by the DRC's specific enumeration this row is a Phase-I-program branch built LATER/SEPARATELY from the seven items P4777 most plausibly totals, not one of its named constituents.
NET: 'Phase I' is used in two senses across the source base -- the DRC's narrow list of 7 named as-built trunks (870km, ~2014 vintage) vs. the CCXI bond report's broader ~1,600km PLANNED Phase I programme that explicitly includes 'Duchang, Yuqian and other branches' (i.e., many more branches than the 7 named trunks). This row plausibly belongs to the broader programme sense but not the narrow named-trunk list P4777 most likely represents. Given the calibration that this double-count signature is 'refuted about as often as confirmed,' and the route-geometry proximity is real but not independently sourced, this is flagged for human review -- NOT recommending a fold, delete, or length change to either P4777 or this row.
